## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.3.2

This maintenance release removes manual benchmark timing.

- Baseline, Optimized, and Focused Profiler measurements now complete automatically after exactly 200 campaign-hour callbacks.
- The benchmark report is written immediately when the target is reached; exiting the game is no longer required to finalize it.
- Focused Profiler mode also finalizes its active profile report at the same target.
- An in-game message confirms that all active reports were written and that the game can be exited normally.
- The target counter resets for every new benchmark session and on teardown.
- The existing MCM modes, career-choice cache validation, profiler targets, benchmark metrics, and Harmony teardown behavior are unchanged.

Two hundred campaign hours equal eight in-game days and eight hours, but players no longer need to watch the campaign clock.
